title: Play an audio file from the Terminal
summary: Use the `afplay` command to play a sound or music file directly from the Terminal. It plays the file and waits until the playback finishes.

steps.explain: Run `afplay` followed by the path to the audio file you want to play. The command will start playback and wait until the file finishes.

placeholders.name: FILE
placeholders.description: The path to the audio file (e.g., .mp3, .wav, .aiff) you want to play.
